name: osc
summary: Wave reader: the 12-waveform OPZ + OPL union (0-7 = OPZ: sine/triangle/half/double derivatives, 8-11 = OPL: rectified/pulse/square/saw) as one Q15 table (`fm1_wave`), selected by a `waveform` param (0 = sine). Waves 9/10/11 (pulse/square/saw) are six band-limited tables each (the top-octave anti-aliasing), the `mip` input (from the phasor's `fm1_wave_mip(step)`) selects the level whose top harmonic sits below Nyquist. Waves 0-8 ignore `mip` (a single, already-band-limited table).
